items.text: OpenAI and Atlassian expanded their partnership to embed GPT-6-family agents into Rovo and the Teamwork Graph.
items.text_zh: OpenAI与Atlassian扩大合作，将GPT-6系列智能体嵌入Rovo及Teamwork Graph。
items.cat_take_en: The integration gives agents organizational context, but permission design remains the key enterprise risk.
items.cat_take_zh: 组织上下文让智能体更实用，但权限边界仍是企业落地的最大风险。

items.text: Ex-Ramp engineers raised $20 million for Melius, an AI platform launched after abandoning their first product.
items.text_zh: 前Ramp工程师为AI平台Melius融资2000万美元，该平台是在放弃首款产品后重新推出的。
items.cat_take_en: The reset suggests investors are funding experienced teams’ iteration speed, not just polished initial ideas.
items.cat_take_zh: 这轮融资说明投资人押注团队迭代能力，而不只是押注首个产品的完成度。

items.text: AI infrastructure startup Lambda is reportedly raising $4 billion ahead of a planned IPO.
items.text_zh: AI基础设施初创公司Lambda据报道正寻求融资40亿美元，为计划中的IPO铺路。
items.cat_take_en: The scale highlights investor appetite for compute infrastructure, while making capital intensity the central constraint.
items.cat_take_zh: 融资规模凸显市场对算力基础设施的热情，也把资本密集度推成核心约束。

items.text: Hark released a privacy-focused AI personal assistant designed to minimize dependence on cloud processing.
items.text_zh: Hark发布主打隐私的AI个人助理，强调减少对云端处理的依赖。
items.cat_take_en: Privacy becomes a product differentiator only if local processing is convenient enough for ordinary users.
items.cat_take_zh: 本地处理若不够方便，隐私就难以真正转化为普通用户愿意付费的产品优势。

items.text: Mirror Particle is building a world model intended to simulate human behavior and social interactions.
items.text_zh: Mirror Particle正在构建用于模拟人类行为和社会互动的世界模型。
items.cat_take_en: Behavior simulation could improve planning, but its value depends on whether synthetic people reflect real populations.
items.cat_take_zh: 行为模拟有望提升规划能力，但前提是虚拟人群不能严重偏离真实社会。

items.text: Google Research described Earth AI’s planetary geospatial foundation models for public-health applications worldwide.
items.text_zh: Google Research介绍Earth AI行星级地理空间基础模型，目标是服务全球公共卫生。
items.cat_take_en: Public-health mapping is a high-value use case, but deployment quality will hinge on regional data coverage.
items.cat_take_zh: 公共卫生制图价值很高，但实际效果将取决于各地区数据覆盖是否均衡。

items.text: AWS published a tutorial for building a voice travel concierge with AgentCore, a managed knowledge base, and Nova Sonic.
items.text_zh: AWS发布教程，展示如何用AgentCore、托管知识库和Nova Sonic构建语音旅行礼宾。
items.cat_take_en: The recipe lowers the barrier to voice agents, but reliability across bookings and changing policies remains unresolved.
items.cat_take_zh: 这套方案降低语音智能体门槛，但预订流程与政策变化下的可靠性仍未解决。

items.text: MongoDB introduced Atlas Agent Engine, a platform for building AI agents directly on enterprise data.
items.text_zh: MongoDB推出Atlas Agent Engine，帮助企业直接基于自身数据构建AI智能体。
items.cat_take_en: Putting agents beside operational data may shorten deployment, but it also concentrates governance responsibility in the database layer.
items.cat_take_zh: 智能体贴近业务数据能缩短部署路径，却也把治理责任集中到了数据库层。

items.text: Figma moved its Figma agent out of beta with improvements to instruction following and output quality.
items.text_zh: Figma宣布Figma agent结束测试版，并改进指令遵循和输出质量。
items.cat_take_en: Leaving beta signals product confidence, but designers will judge it by editability rather than impressive first drafts.
items.cat_take_zh: 正式出测试版体现产品信心，但设计师最终看重的是可编辑性而非惊艳初稿。

items.text: ElevenLabs launched Agents Architect, which builds and revises workplace agents from prompts, files, and conversation history.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs推出Agents Architect，可根据提示、文件和对话历史构建并修改工作场景智能体。
items.cat_take_en: Versioned drafts make agent creation more governable, giving teams a practical rollback mechanism.
items.cat_take_zh: 版本化草稿让智能体创建更可控，也为团队提供了实用的回滚机制。

items.text: Claude gained integrations with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides, allowing users to edit Workspace files beside the chat.
items.text_zh: Claude新增Google文档、表格和演示文稿集成，可在聊天旁直接协同编辑Workspace文件。
items.cat_take_en: The sidebar workflow reduces context switching, while access permissions become the decisive trust test.
items.cat_take_zh: 侧边栏协作减少了切换成本，但访问权限将成为决定用户信任的关键考验。

items.text: Canva became the fourth most-used AI platform on the web, according to a16z data shared by Canva.
items.text_zh: Canva援引a16z数据称，其已成为全球网页端使用量第四高的AI平台。
items.cat_take_en: Distribution is Canva’s advantage, but usage rankings do not prove that users retain or pay for AI features.
items.cat_take_zh: Canva的优势在分发规模，但使用排名并不能证明用户会长期留存或为AI功能付费。

items.text: South Korea committed $3.49 billion to develop a domestic frontier AI model to compete with leading Chinese systems.
items.text_zh: 韩国投入34.9亿美元开发本土前沿AI模型，目标是与中国领先系统竞争。
items.cat_take_en: The commitment strengthens national capability, but public funding must overcome talent and compute bottlenecks.
items.cat_take_zh: 政府投入能增强国家能力，但人才与算力瓶颈仍可能限制资金转化为成果。

items.text: LibreOffice declared “no AI” a software feature, positioning user control and offline operation against compulsory AI integration.
items.text_zh: LibreOffice将“不含AI”定义为软件功能，以用户控制和离线运行为强制集成AI的替代方案。
items.cat_take_en: The stance gives privacy-conscious users a clear choice, but may limit access to productivity gains from embedded assistance.
items.cat_take_zh: 这一立场为重视隐私的用户提供了选择，却可能牺牲内置助手带来的效率提升。
